_about: Wyckoff Living NOW. v21 (Franchise Bands S2, 30 Oct 2026) = v20 extending ix/email-tokens-v20.json (the franchise band sizes). Nothing else changed. v20 (Title Design S1, 26 Oct 2026): every WLN colour, font and the logo now come from WLN's TITLES record (render Worker v1.22.0); the platform file mixes every other shade. What is left here is only the six house-ad pictures, which carry the town name. They move to each house ad's record in the ADS collection (title fields review G7); when they do, WLN's TITLES-ADMIN Email Tokens File points at templates/ix/email-tokens-v19.json directly and this file retires. The splash overrides are gone (G8): the splash takes WLN's own colours. Provisional HC-P-TD1-4.
